title: The Gym Personality Field Guide: A short documentary about gym personality
caption:
A short documentary about gym personality

You've seen every one of these. Denial is free:
1️⃣ The Mirror Mayor — Came to lift phones, not weights. 45 minutes of angles, 5 minutes of curls squeezed between selfies.
2️⃣ The Machine Hog — Claims six machines with one towel. His rest between sets is an entire podcast episode.
3️⃣ The Silent Grunter — Every rep sounds like a dolphin in a blender. You hear him three aisles before you see him.
4️⃣ The Treadmill Tourist — Walks at speed 3, full makeup, reading a magazine. Has never sweat in this building. Suspicious.

Tag the friend who is #1 (they won't admit it).
